# Anne Shirley

## Overview

- **Age:** eleven years old (initially)  <sub>[v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c33 P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v2 c10 P4](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anne is a girl with gray eyes and a small, pointed chin. She has bright hair, which was once long, red braids, but she accidentally dyed it green with a peddler's dye and had to have it clipped short.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 c15 P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v1 c28 P24](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0024), [v2 c1 P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058)_

## Personality

Anne is highly imaginative, enthusiastic, and exceptionally talkative. She possesses an intense emotional nature, holding onto grudges with firm tenacity while loving her close friends deeply. She is also reckless and prone to impulsive actions, though she readily accepts responsibility when she makes a mistake.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c17 P39](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0039), [v1 c19 P74](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0074), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v2 c2 P33](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0033)_

## History

Anne Shirley came to live at Green Gables with Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert at the age of eleven. She attended school in Avonlea under Mr. Phillips and later Miss Stacy, forming a deep friendship with Diana Barry and entering a intense academic rivalry with Gilbert Blythe. She took part in local school concerts and formed the Avonlea Village Improvement Society as its secretary. After preparing in the Queen's class, she attended Queen's Academy to earn her teacher's license alongside her classmates. Following her studies, she chose to stay in Avonlea to teach local children and assist Marilla.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P17](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0017), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c38 P29](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0029), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)_
